standard.summary: topk=保留 top-k% 困难样本; threshold=保留 loss > threshold 的样本。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.topk: 固定拿最难的 K 个，K 越大噪声也可能越多。
optionDescriptions.threshold: 过阈值才算难例，阈值高就更少更尖。

standard_en.summary: topk = keep the hardest top-k% of samples; threshold = keep the samples whose loss exceeds the threshold.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.topk: Always takes the K hardest; the larger K is, the more noise may come with it.
optionDescriptions.threshold: Only what clears the threshold counts as hard, so a high threshold gives fewer, sharper cases.

advanced.principle: topk=保留 top-k% 困难样本; threshold=保留 loss > threshold 的样本。

advanced_en.principle: topk = keep the top-k% hardest samples; threshold = keep samples with loss > threshold.
